about_the_game:
ABOUT THIS CONTENT

Bring the heat to your desktop with the Helping the Hotties – Wallpaper Pack!

Each wallpaper captures your favourite characters in brand-new poses, outfits, and settings – perfect for spicing up your screen or simply admiring the beauty of the Hotties outside the game.

With this DLC you will get:

- 128 new wallpapers in amazing 4K resolution with all the girls from the game.

- Rendered in gorgeous 4K resolution (3840x2160)

- A mix of romantic, flirty, and sultry scenes

Note: This DLC is purely cosmetic and does not add new in-game content or story elements.

content_descriptors.notes: This is only a DLC pack with still images and some animations of the characters from the game. No story or dialogue.
